request.description: Create a new satellite schedule. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission. scheduleType: Regular | Holiday. status: DRAFT | ACTIVE | ARCHIVED (optional). effectiveTo must be after effectiveFrom.

response.name: Success

request.description: List satellite schedules with optional filters. Requires VIEW_SCHEDULES permission. Query params: page, limit, name, nameSlug, status (DRAFT|ACTIVE|ARCHIVED), scheduleType (Regular|Holiday), effectiveFromAfter, effectiveFromBefore, effectiveToAfter, effectiveToBefore (ISO date strings).
Get a satellite schedule by ID. Requires VIEW_SCHEDULES permission.

Update a satellite schedule. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission. All body fields optional: name, nameSlug, effectiveFrom, effectiveTo, scheduleType (Regular|Holiday), status (DRAFT|ACTIVE|ARCHIVED). effectiveTo must be after effectiveFrom when both provided.
Delete a satellite schedule by ID. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission.

Create a schedule block within a satellite schedule. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission. Time is specified in Ethiopian format (hour 1-12, minute 0-59, dayPart: ጠዋት|ከሰአት|ማታ|ሌሊት). dayOfWeek: MONDAY-SUNDAY. broadcastType: Fresh_Content|First_Rerun|Second_Rerun|Third_Rerun|Bonus_Slot. durationMinutes is optional (defaults to show's totalDurationMinutes). Schedule must be in DRAFT status.
Create multiple schedule blocks at once. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission. Validates no overlaps among new blocks and with existing blocks on the same day. Schedule must be in DRAFT status.

List all schedule blocks for a satellite schedule. Requires VIEW_SCHEDULES permission. Optional filters: dayOfWeek (MONDAY-SUNDAY), showId (UUID), broadcastType (Fresh_Content|First_Rerun|Second_Rerun|Third_Rerun|Bonus_Slot). Response includes both Gregorian and Ethiopian time representations.
Get a specific schedule block by ID. Requires VIEW_SCHEDULES permission.

Update a schedule block. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission. All body fields optional. When updating time (hour, minute, dayPart must all be provided together). Validates no overlaps after update. Schedule must be in DRAFT status.
Delete a schedule block by ID. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission. Schedule must be in DRAFT status.

Generate broadcast slots from weekly schedule block templates for a date range. Schedule must be ACTIVE. If fromDate/toDate are omitted, uses the schedule's effectiveFrom/effectiveTo. Idempotent: existing slots are skipped. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission.
List broadcast slots for a schedule with optional filters: status (SCHEDULED|AIRED|MISSED|PREEMPTED|CANCELLED), dayOfWeek, showId, broadcastType, dateFrom, dateTo. Requires VIEW_SCHEDULES permission.
Get a single broadcast slot by ID. Returns both Gregorian and Ethiopian time/date representations. Requires VIEW_SCHEDULES permission.

Update a broadcast slot. Can override time (hour/minute/dayPart in Ethiopian), duration, status, label, or overrideReason. Status transitions: SCHEDULED can go to AIRED|MISSED|PREEMPTED|CANCELLED. PREEMPTED can go back to SCHEDULED. Terminal states (AIRED, MISSED, CANCELLED) cannot be changed. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission.
Delete a broadcast slot by ID. Only slots with SCHEDULED status can be deleted. Requires MANAGE_SCHEDULES permission.
Create a new advertisement. Requires MANAGE_ADVERTS permission.
Create a payment request. Requires MANAGE_FINANCE permission.
Propose compensation for an advert. Requires MANAGE_ADVERTS permission.
Get analytics summary including sales by show. Requires VIEW_ANALYTICS permission.
